title: Prometeo · continuidad y orquestación entre chats
mission: Build Prometeo as a portable multi-root cognitive operating system that survives chat/model loss, gives many identical fresh chats guide-grade cognitive posture, lets them self-assign/chain/discover/verify/integrate/recover useful work under scoped authority, and recursively increases useful durable progress with decreasing human coordination.
human_goal: The human can paste `/wc` into many fresh chats, potentially 50+, without numbering or routing them. Workers organize distinct or intentionally complementary work, continue sequential checkpoints, recover stalled attempts, discover future work, and integrate routine page changes locally. The human uses `/g` only when they want the global guide and `.` for a durable guide execution cycle, not as a mandatory merger after every worker wave.
success_conditions: Fresh guide reincarnation without transcript or old-chat lookup.
Any fresh /wc worker reconstructs the binding worker cognitive kernel and exact current durable state without human context transport.
A broad identical-worker wave spreads across distinct/complementary work rather than duplicating exclusive mutations.
One worker can continue through sequential same-context checkpoints and atomically claim a newly-unblocked successor without duplicate execution.
Prepared work exhaustion triggers deduplicated discovery/recovery before idle, without filler work.
Stalled attempts become suspect/recoverable under explicit time/evidence rules; recovery is append-only/CAS-safe and late returns remain evidence.
Plan de acción/Universal Control, Prometeo móvil, Facultad Digital/Study Library and Alumnos/página docente each support local planner -> micro-swarm -> local steward loops.
Routine page integration does not require the global guide; only cross-root/shared-owner/high-authority conflicts escalate.
Executable Planner compiler generates N+1 from durable returns/dispositions and later N+2 through the same path without human task wording.
Context Fabric/Working Sets give each role enough strategic posture and exact evidence without unnecessary repository-wide rereading.
Fresh critics/validators remain independent from generators and can change/falsify routes.
Useful durable results per human intervention materially improves across generations; chat count alone is not success.
Parent can disappear mid-loop and a successor continues.
Live/Universal Control is a derived work/control surface, not a source of truth.
current_frontier: GEN2 closed-loop implementation remains preserved. In parallel, Universal Cognitive Worker /wc v3.0 is now the active broad high-parallelism canary. Q-UNIVERSAL-COGNITIVE-SWARM-01 contains 60 staged opportunities: 52 explicitly READY at publication and 8 dependency-gated successors. The READY set includes executable worker infrastructure, four surface-specific seven-lens micro-swarms, independent critics, metrics and historical mechanism archaeology. Dependency-derived local stewards then integrate each page/root, followed by cross-surface integration, ~50-worker stress verification, fresh strategic criticism and production-readiness disposition. This creates enough explicit useful frontier for a large identical-worker wave now, while leaving /w production promotion evidence-gated.
next_human_action: Open many fresh chats with the exact same `/wc` bootstrap. A wave of about 50 is intentionally supported by the current prepared canary frontier; no unique codes are needed. Do not interpret this as a production /w guarantee until the stress/critic gates return evidence.
authority_law: Workers may think as broadly as the guide but may mutate only their claimed/authorized candidate scopes. Generated queues, local stewards, worker returns and critics do not self-promote Human Accepted, Current, Catalog, Lineage or Served authority.
update_law: Material changes to goals, method, architecture, memory, roots/surfaces, generation inputs/outputs, queues/claims/runs/returns/recovery, local integration, verification or frontier must be durable before relying on conversation memory.
